FAQ

Questions
Answered.

Who is ScalD for? +
ScalD is for business owners, coaches, consultants, and entrepreneurs who have real expertise but are missing the marketing and sales infrastructure to scale it. If you know what you're selling but can't consistently get it in front of buyers and convert them — that's exactly the gap we fill.
How quickly will I see results? +
Most partners see measurable traction within the first 30–60 days. Lone Star Notary saw a 50% lift in booked appointments within month one. Real scaling momentum typically compounds from month three onward as the systems mature and we have data to optimize against.
What makes ScalD different from a regular agency? +
Agencies take your money and deliver reports. We take revenue share and deliver results. We're operators — we build the website, the funnel, the CRM, the content system, and the sales team as one integrated machine. If it doesn't convert, we don't win. That changes everything about how we work.
Do you work with any business or are you selective? +
We are selective. We only take on partners we're confident we can move the needle for — and we maintain niche exclusivity, meaning we never work with two direct competitors. If we don't think we can help you, we'll tell you on the strategy call.
What services does ScalD provide? +
We provide end-to-end growth infrastructure: full content strategy and social media buildout, lead funnel design and deployment, GoHighLevel CRM buildout and automation, AI chatbot and lead qualification systems, sales team deployment (setters and closers), media outreach and press placement, and ongoing lead generation optimization and strategy.
How do I get started? +
Book a free strategy call. We'll review your current situation, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and give you a clear picture of what we'd build first. No pressure, no pitch deck — just an honest conversation about what's actually possible for your business.

Lone Star Notary & Financial Planning is a Texas-licensed notary and insurance broker serving the DFW area and statewide. When they came to us, they had zero social media presence, no content strategy, and every single lead required manual effort to find and chase. We built their entire digital footprint from scratch — a full social media presence across platforms, a content strategy designed to consistently attract their ideal clients, and a lead funnel system that captured, pre-qualified, and converted prospects into booked appointments automatically. Within the first month, booked appointments jumped 50%. Revenue grew 60% over the engagement.

What We Built
  • ◆ Full social media presence build — accounts set up, branded, and activated across platforms from zero to a consistent, lead-generating footprint
  • ◆ Content strategy and execution — platform-specific content plan, posting cadence, and messaging built to attract and convert the right clients organically
  • ◆ Content-driven lead funnel — organic content feeding directly into a lead capture and pre-qualification system that worked around the clock

Overview

Mayfair Garden Express is a Dallas-based restaurant serving a unique fusion of international cuisine rooted in authentic flavors and culture. When they came to us, they had 362 total views across all their social media — virtually invisible online. We built the entire content plan from scratch, repositioned their brand around their authentic story and community roots, and engineered a social presence that made the DFW market stop and pay attention. The result? Over 1.1 million views, 400%+ follower growth — and media features on both FOX 4 Good Day DFW and NBC News that put them on the map with the entire Dallas-Fort Worth market.

What We Built
  • ◆ Full content strategy — brand voice, content pillars, hook frameworks, and a posting schedule built for consistent, compounding growth
  • ◆ Short-form video production — scripting, filming direction, editing, and publishing for TikTok and Instagram Reels optimized for the algorithm
  • ◆ Trending audio and hook strategy — each piece of content led with a pattern-interrupting hook designed to stop the scroll and drive watch time
  • ◆ Platform optimization — bio, highlights, profile positioning, and cross-posting strategy to maximize reach with every post
  • ◆ Media outreach and press coverage — built and pitched the media angles that secured features on both FOX 4 Good Day DFW and NBC News, introducing Mayfair to the broader DFW market
  • ◆ Community engagement strategy — respond protocols and engagement tactics that turned viewers into loyal followers and customers

Overview

Wix had leads. They had a product. What they didn't have was a sales infrastructure capable of converting that interest into consistent, predictable cash. Without a proper setting and closing system, qualified prospects were slipping through the cracks and revenue was inconsistent at best. We came in and built the entire sales operation from scratch — sourcing and vetting the team, writing the scripts, training every rep from the ground up, and installing an accountability system that kept performance high every single day. In under four months, $200,000 in cash was collected. The pipeline became a machine.

What We Built
  • ◆ Full setter and closer system design — role definitions, compensation structure, KPI benchmarks, and daily workflow protocols
  • ◆ Sales rep sourcing and vetting — identified, interviewed, and onboarded high-performance setters and closers aligned with the brand and offer
  • ◆ Comprehensive training program — script mastery, objection handling frameworks, tonality coaching, and live call reviews
  • ◆ CRM pipeline build — deal stages, pipeline views, custom fields, and activity tracking to keep every lead accounted for
  • ◆ KPI dashboard and accountability system — daily performance tracking, leaderboards, and weekly coaching sessions to maintain output
  • ◆ Offer structure and pricing optimization — refined the core offer positioning to maximize close rate and average deal value

Overview

This client was generating leads but had no system behind them. Every follow-up was manual, show-up rates were inconsistent, and leads were going cold within hours of opting in. We built a complete GoHighLevel infrastructure from the ground up — a fully mapped pipeline, custom tag taxonomy, automated nurture sequences, and 12+ published workflows that work around the clock. Every lead that enters the system gets nurtured, reminded, re-engaged, and moved through the pipeline automatically. The team went from manually chasing every lead to having a back-end machine that handles the heavy lifting.

What We Built
  • ◆ Full GoHighLevel account architecture — pipeline stages, contact fields, smart lists, and custom views tailored to the business model
  • ◆ 12+ published automated workflows — including lead intake, nurture sequences, discovery call booking, no-show recovery, and post-sale onboarding
  • ◆ Custom tag taxonomy system — a full tagging structure that tracks every contact's behavior, stage, and engagement level for precision follow-up
  • ◆ Multi-channel nurture sequences — email + SMS campaigns, proof sequences, and value delivery automated across the entire buyer journey
  • ◆ No-show recovery automation — automated same-day and 24-hour follow-up sequences that recover missed appointments and re-book prospects
  • ◆ Monthly reporting and DFW market automation — scheduled market report workflows that run on autopilot and keep the audience engaged
